"""VLABench put_box_on_painting controller; all motion uses the public robot client."""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
DT = 0.1
CAMERAS = ["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"]
LAYOUT = ["joint1_pos", "joint2_pos", "joint3_pos", "joint4_pos", "joint5_pos", "joint6_pos", "joint7_pos",
          "joint1_vel", "joint2_vel", "joint3_vel", "joint4_vel", "joint5_vel", "joint6_vel", "joint7_vel",
          "finger1_pos", "finger2_pos", "tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z", "tcp_qw", "tcp_qx", "tcp_qy", "tcp_qz"]


def state(res):
    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)


def qconj(q):
    return np.r_[q[0], -q[1:]]


def qmul(a, b):
    aw, ax, ay, az = a
    bw, bx, by, bz = b
    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])


def rotvec_between(q0, q1):
    q0 = q0 / np.linalg.norm(q0)
    q1 = q1 / np.linalg.norm(q1)
    dq = qmul(q1, qconj(q0))
    if dq[0] < 0:
        dq = -dq
    n = np.linalg.norm(dq[1:])
    if n < 1e-10:
        return 2*dq[1:]
    angle = 2*np.arctan2(n, np.clip(dq[0], -1, 1))
    return dq[1:] * (angle/n)


def pose(s):
    return np.r_[s[16:19], s[19:23]]


def command(robot, arm, fingers=(0.04, 0.04), duration=0.3, note=""):
    n = int(round(duration/DT))
    row = np.r_[arm, fingers]
    actions = np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0)
    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="linear", cameras=[], video="none", note=note)


def calibrate_position_orientation_jacobian(robot):
    s0 = state(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none"))
    q0 = s0[:7].copy()
    records = []
    eps = 0.025
    for j in range(7):
        b = state(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none"))
        arm = b[:7].copy()
        target = arm.copy()
        target[j] += eps
        command(robot, target, duration=0.4, note=f"small joint {j+1} calibration motion")
        p = state(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none"))
        d = p[:7] - b[:7]
        records.append((d.copy(), p[16:19]-b[16:19], rotvec_between(b[19:23], p[19:23])))
        command(robot, arm, duration=0.4, note=f"return from joint {j+1} calibration motion")
    # Local mapping from measured joint changes to measured TCP translation and rotation.
    D = np.asarray([r[0] for r in records])
    X = np.asarray([r[1] for r in records])
    W = np.asarray([r[2] for r in records])
    Jp = (np.linalg.pinv(D) @ X).T
    Jr = (np.linalg.pinv(D) @ W).T
    np.savez(f"{OUT}/local_jacobian.npz", Jp=Jp, Jr=Jr, probe_joint_deltas=D, probe_position_deltas=X,
             probe_rotation_deltas=W, q_start=q0)
    return Jp, Jr, state(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none"))


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    with open(f"{OUT}/spec.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(spec, f, indent=2, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x))
    if robot.status()["control_steps"] == 0:
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        obs.save(f"{OUT}/initial_observation")
    Jp, Jr, s = calibrate_position_orientation_jacobian(robot)
    np.set_printoptions(precision=5, suppress=True)
    print("status", robot.status())
    print("state", s)
    print("Jp\n", Jp)
    print("Jr\n", Jr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
